title: Closing a task now stops everything it started

owner_note.text: Closing a task now stops its servers and browsers and removes its merged worktrees from git and disk, with one logged line of what it closed or could not; a rerunnable test proves it (11 checks). I did not unload whisper/recite when idle, because dictation would stall on a 14 s cold start; that is recorded as an improvement.
